name: 92543 · Hemet, CA
findings: ZIP 92543 (Hemet) has 82 nonprofit organizations. 29 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 25 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 92543 (Hemet) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
69% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 92543 (Hemet) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 63% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 13 organizations here; 67% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
